document.cue: Describe someone you know who has an interesting job.

text: I'd like to talk about my uncle Marat, who works as a pilot for a big airline. He is my mother's younger brother, and he is forty years old. I don't see him very often, because he is often abroad, but we talk on the phone every week.

He flies passenger planes between Kazakhstan and different countries in Europe and Asia. Every month he flies about eighty hours, and he spends many nights in hotels in other cities. Before each flight he checks the weather and the plane with the other pilots. During the flight he has to be very careful and calm, especially when the weather is bad. He told me that the most difficult part is the landing, because everything must be perfect. After a long flight he usually sleeps for a day and then he spends time with his family. Sometimes he brings me small gifts from the countries he visits.

I think his job is very interesting for several reasons. First, he can see many countries and different cultures, which is something that most people can't do. Second, he has an important responsibility, because hundreds of people trust him with their lives. Also, the view from the plane is amazing, and he often sends me photos of beautiful sunsets above the clouds. Of course, the job is hard and tiring, but I admire him very much. Maybe one day I will fly with him as a passenger.

tips.en: He told me that brings in someone else's view and adds variety.
